subject.title: No owner role on an org I created

question: After verifying the xerg creation audit and authenticated actor, should staff restore jasonacurry as owner and preserve evidence for a root-cause investigation?
rationale: Changing an existing organization’s owner role affects authorization and production data, so identity and creation provenance must be confirmed by someone with appropriate operational access.

options.title: Verify and repair
options.body: Confirm the creation actor and membership history, restore owner membership if they match the report, and retain the issue for regression investigation.

options.title: Request identity evidence
options.body: If audit records are inconclusive, request an authenticated support confirmation before changing organization ownership.

recommendation.title: Verify and repair
recommendation.body: Confirm the creation actor and membership history, restore owner membership if they match the report, and retain the issue for regression investigation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history-based candidate connected to the self-service organization creation feature.
